documentation.summary: Provides decoded network state and scoped network-state changes.
details: The live Layer treats values from expo-network as untrusted and decodes them before exposing them to application code.
Connection and internet reachability remain distinct because a connected interface does not guarantee external network access.

platforms.name: android
platforms.behavior: Uses expo-network and requires the access-network-state and access-wifi-state permissions declared by Expo.

platforms.name: ios
platforms.behavior: Uses expo-network without additional application permissions.

platforms.name: web
platforms.behavior: The connection type can be UNKNOWN because browser network-information APIs are not universally available.

documentation.summary: Reads and decodes the device's current network state.
failures: Fails with NetworkUnavailable when the native method is unavailable.
Fails with NetworkContractViolation when the native result does not satisfy NetworkState.
Fails with NetworkNativeError when the native request rejects.

documentation.summary: Emits decoded network states from a scoped native subscription.
failures: Fails with NetworkUnavailable when listener registration reports that the native module is unavailable.
Fails with NetworkContractViolation when a native event does not satisfy NetworkState.
Fails with NetworkNativeError when listener registration fails.
